elements.id: Magic:Mask of the Spiritlord, Earth Spirit
elements.name: Mask of the Spiritlord, Earth Spirit
elements.desc:
Wondrous Item, unique

This mask from an ironwood tree allows the spiritlord to play host to the spirit-elementals roaming this world.

Vigilant Spirits. Starting at 10th level, you gain resistance to poison damage.
